method: Independent read-only assessment against saved prompts and ACCEPTANCE.md. Application outcomes are separate from skill selection and full instruction-read evidence. No trial was rerun by this grader.

trials.assessment: Concrete read-only comparison outcome, observed twelve-package/two-file layout, selected-package acceptance including missing/modified/unrelated contents, meaningful non-goals, and open symlink/reference/output decisions. Explicit selection or all is a labeled proposal; no implementation claimed.
limits: Does not assess actual installed equality or settle the future CLI contract.

trials.assessment: Correct split-before-one-decode and resolve-before-component-containment sequence; concrete delimiter, traversal, symlink and prefix alternatives; history distinguished from inferred motivation; current implementation executed on both entrypoints and in-memory comparisons support examples.
limits: Regression source inspected but filesystem fixture suite not rerun; race and browser-semantic limits are explicit.

trials.assessment: Correct active HTML/script binding, state/handler locations, Pause/Step/Replay causality, finite completion, explicit Play under reduced motion, and visibility/preference boundary walkthrough. Historical browser observations are hash-linked and clearly separated from fresh source analysis.
trials.selection_note: Initial run loaded installed se-proof only; missing primary se-where/se-how selection remains a routing miss even though the requested explanation passes.
limits: Node syntax check is observed; no new browser execution or hide/show runtime evidence is claimed.

trials.assessment: Project-derived dependency order, stable final integration gate, manifest timing, invalidation rules, local-versus-release authority and actual checks are correct. Portable validator and JS syntax ran; initial installation inventory discrepancy was traced to excluded .DS_Store and corrected comparison showed twelve matches.
trials.selection_note: Installed se-when and se-proof loaded. Repository se-verify subject-matter reads support cited gate rules but do not establish installed se-verify selection. Direct assessment fulfills requested responsibilities without turning this separate selection miss into an application failure.
limits: Separate focused HTML and independent suites honestly NOT_RUN; this evaluates an unspecified future change and does not pass that future release or verify live host routing.

evidence: expertise delegated url_containment_review own-turn native trace
trials.assessment: Suitable explorer reviewer selected for a bounded Python/path security review. Native child metadata links /root/url_containment_review to the trial parent; own-turn calls actually read validator/tests/docs, with no edits or recursive delegation, and the child returned a scoped conclusion. Parent source review plus real-entrypoint/five in-memory checks independently substantiate conclusion and proposed next action.
trials.selection_note: Child performed no installed skill read in its own turn. Inherited parent history must not count as child selection; task application and that routing omission remain separate.
limits: Public JSONL alone omits child launch/results; native child audit was needed. Child ran no tests; parent checks are explicitly separate. Symlink/traversal fixture behavior was source-reviewed, not newly exercised.

trials.assessment: Standalone page accurately animates valid encoded-path and traversal denial; uses finite intentional controls, static transcript, reduced-motion/manual operation, source references and no external dependencies. Exact illustrated URLs ran through real validator, including assertion that containment rejection precedes existence. Browser final-source literals match artifact bytes, and tested earlier control-script bytes equal final script. Nine regressions, final package validator, preserved prior files/manifest entries and final only-two-path diff are evidenced.

overall: Six requested application outcomes pass within their recorded limits. This is not an all-skills selection pass; initial primary-skill omissions, child own-context selection and truncated instruction reads require separate grading/remediation.
